facts: Existing four Save scopes are synchronous sequential locals; no Save call invokes Capture and no Capture helper invokes Save. No coroutine/deferred filesystem writer.

Concrete CheckedStorageFile stream methods only invoke CheckedStorage. Production fault callback is compiled out; strict candidate Hook classifies single-shot state without writer calls. Read trace production inert; candidate callback only observer packet classification, no Save/Capture call.
CheckSavedConfig is seek/read/CRC only; validator pure semantic/RGB checks and never runs during owned copy I/O. Native encode callback validates lease and emits bytes, no persistence dispatch.

Core0 setup/Configurator/mode lane is sole Config/filesystem writer. Existing pinned IRQ/core1 resource reports show no Save/Capture/slot acquisition. USB callbacks service endpoint/FIFO only; no recursive foreground Configurator dispatch from file I/O.
Host fault hooks used by tests only observe/count/inject, no Save/Capture reentry. New slot use must preserve these invariants; no lock/refusal/extra slot permitted.
limits: Source-grounded proof, not runtime concurrency measurement or generic reentrancy promise; recheck after implementation and fresh review.
